value.rationale: The number of deleted sites and number of surviving one-vertex components are elementary but structurally competing natural site-percolation observables. Their dependence can change sign, and a single interior parameter has cancellation across all linear-order contributions, leaving an anomalously small positive covariance. The exact formula identifies the switch and finite-size correction in a well-studied model, making the parameter threshold and independence of Gaussian limits potentially useful to cluster-count fluctuation studies; this is not an arbitrary slice or textbook arithmetic identity.
